regions.today: It will be mostly cloudy but dry this evening with a few bright spells developing further east. Southeasterly winds will be moderate to fresh, easing later on.
regions.tonight: It will continue dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Some patchy mist and fog will develop overnight. Lows of 6 to 10 degrees with light variable or southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: It will be dry for most of the day tomorrow with sunny spells. Patchy mist, rain and drizzle will spread from the west later in the evening. Highs of 12 to 15 degrees with light variable or southerly winds.
